g11_contract.joint_success: Coupling-proven via dashboard rendering N coupled REDs from one mutation + single-edit fix repairs all N

handoff_sections.pre_flight_checklist: SSOT P2-D2=DONE, G10=YES, activeTask=P2-E1, anchor held, sandbox 20/20 GREEN at HEAD, pre-revert tags p2-d1-pre-injection + macro-pre-inject in place

handoff_sections.injection_protocol: Step 1: git tag p2-e1-pre-injection HEAD (before mutation). Step 2: Edit primitive constant (single line, clearly wrong value). Step 3: Verify sandbox exit 1 + ≥2 FAIL + dashboard RED. Step 4: Hard gates clean. Step 5: git commit injection (L84 staging). Step 6: Document dashboard state.
handoff_sections.fix_protocol: Dev diagnoses from ≥2 RED cards. Single edit: restore constant to original value. Verify byte-identical vs p2-e1-pre-injection tag. Sandbox 20/20 GREEN. All hard gates clean post-fix. Commit fix with clear subject.
handoff_sections.qa_verification: AC-1: pre-tag + different primitive + ≥2 FAIL + coupling. AC-2: single-edit fix + byte-identical + zone clean. AC-3: coupling-proven (1 mutation → ≥2 failures, 1 fix → GREEN). AC-4: G11 terminal ready (2 trials proven, protocol repeatable).
